title: The Maharashtra Agricultural Debtors Relief Act.
full_text: The Maharashtra Agricultural Debtors Relief Act. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 194728 Act Number: 28 Enactment Date: 1947-05-27 Act Year: 1947 Short Title: The Maharashtra Agricultural Debtors Relief Act. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development and Fisheries Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section The Maharashtra Agricultural Debtors Relief Act. CHAPTER I PRELIMINARY CHAPTER II PROCEDURE FOR ADJUSTMENT OF DEBTS CHAPTER IIA REGISTRATION OF AWARDS CHAPTER III INSOLVENCY PROCEEDINGS CHAPTER IV MISCELLANEOUS Section 1. Short title and extent. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Savings. Section 4. Application for adjustment of debts. Section 5. Every creditor and debtor to file a true and correct statement before Court. Section 6. Application by debtor jointly and severally liable. Section 7. Assignees from non-debtor not entitled to benefit of this Act. Section 8. Application for recording settlement. Section 9. Settlement during pendency of proceedings before Court. Section 10. Certain settlement to be void. Section 11. Application under section 4 or 8 to be made only in respect of debtor whose debts are not more than Rs. 15,000. Section 12. Withdrawal of applications. Section 13. Consolidation of applications. Section 13A. Power of Civil Judge to refer for disposal certain applications to Joint Civil Judge. Section 14. Service of notice on debtors and creditors to submit statement of debts. Section 15. Debts in respect of which no application for adjustment or settlement is made to be void. Section 16. Duties of debtors and creditors. Section 17. Preliminary issues. Section 18. Deleted. Section 19. Transfer of pending suits, appeals, applications and proceedings to the Court. Section 20. Taking of accounts. Section 21. Examination of creditor and debtor. Section 22. Mode of taking accounts. Section 23. In certain cases rent may be charged in lieu of profits. Section 24. Power of Court to declare transfer purporting to be sale to be in nature of mortgage. Section 25. Provisions of section 24 not to apply to certain transfers and transferees. Section 26. Notice to Collector co-operative societies, Registrar, local authorities and others. Section 27. Court's duty to determine particulars, value, etc., of property. Section 28. Fraudulent alienations or incumbrances void. Section 29. Value of property of debtor to be determined by Court in prescribed manner. Section 30. Paying capacity. Section 31. Debts payable by debtors to be scaled down. Section 32. Award. Section 33. Court to prepare scheme for adjustment of debts through provincial Land Mortgage Bank. Section 34. No recovery of amount in excess of debts scaled down. Section 35. Debts not to be scaled down in case of collusion. Section 36. Ex parte proceedings if any party does not appear. Section 37. Re-opening of award and re-adjustment of debts. Section 38. Award to be registered: how executed. Section 39. Postponement of payment of instalment in case of remissions, etc. Section 40. No alienation by debtor before discharge of debts valid. Section 41. Court may order sale of debtor's property in liquidation of his debt. Section 42. Pleaders, etc., excluded from appearance. Section 43. Appeals. Section 43A. Power of District Judge to refer for disposal certain appeals to Assistant Judge or Civil Judge empowered to hear appeals. Section 44. Court-fees. Section 45. Notice how served. Section 46. Provisions of Civil Procedure Code to apply to proceedings. Section 46A. Debt Adjustment Register and Index. Section 46B. Court to send awards and memorandums to Registrars and Sub-Registrars. Section 46C. Notice of appeals to Registrars. Section 46D. Registration. Section 46E. Registration of awards under repealed Act. Section 46F. Notice of awards. Section 46G. Application of Indian Registration Act. Section 47. Court to declare debtor insolvent in certain circumstances. Section 48. Procedure in insolvency proceedings. Section 49. Distribution of assets of insolvent. Section 50. Bar to application in insolvency in other courts. Section 51. Appeals barred. Section 51A. Bar of civil suits or proceedings. Section 52. Period of proceeding before Courts under this Act to be excluded. Section 53. Alienation of standing crops, etc., before repayment of loan prohibited. Section 54. Power of State Government to authorize any person to advance loans to debtors. Section 55. Rules. Section 56. Repeal of Act XVII of 1879 and Bom. XXVIII of 1939. Section 57. Special provision for application under section 4 in respect of debts due to creditor in merged territory. Section 58. Special provision for application under section 24 in respect of land situate in merged territories.
